name: ModelVariant142_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant142_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (up to 64 textured quads leave the command's slot part and fly to points spread around the other slot, each bursting into four smaller quads on arrival, while two spinning triangle fans fade on the slot's fan parts and the third slot's ambient light dims and recovers. The return value reports the hit (1), the end (2) or a still-moving entry); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-159 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant159_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
